post.summary: Create an exact asynchronous close for distribution targets
post.description: Targets are selected only by frozen distribution target IDs. An empty target_ids value means all still-attributable targets; symbol, strategy and ticket filters are not accepted. Retain the original key and complete body after an uncertain result.

202.description: Distribution close durably accepted, not necessarily executed by MT
